panel.introduction: 9P/Tempel 1 was visited by Deep Impact in 2005 and Stardust-NExT in 2011. Their images constrain the published nucleus model. In Source constraints, solid gray marks stereo control and blue marks limb silhouettes. The gray grid identifies poorly constrained regions in both views.

facts.label: Stereo coverage
facts.value: 480 stereo control points on about 70% of the nucleus

moreFacts.label: Presentation
moreFacts.value: Published PDS shape model, including poorly constrained source estimates. Both views use the gray grid for source-flagged poorly constrained regions. Source constraints keeps solid gray for stereo control and blue for limb silhouettes. Grid regions lack those constraints; they are not necessarily wholly unobserved. These are evidence categories, not surface colors. The combined model pole is retained at RA 255°, Dec +64.5°. Rotational phase is arbitrary and held fixed; no encounter or current rotation reconstruction is claimed.

controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Complete published PDS shape, simplified for display. The gray grid identifies source-flagged poorly constrained regions; solid gray covers stereo-controlled and limb-constrained regions. These are model materials, not observed albedo. Source constraints distinguishes the two better-constrained categories.
